content.text: /ext:medcp How many inpatient encounters included a diagnosis of pneumonia in the past year?
I'll check the clinical database schema first, then query for inpatient pneumonia encounters.

This is an OMOP CDM database. Inpatient encounters are visits in `visit_occurrence` with an inpatient visit concept; pneumonia is a condition. Let me query for inpatient visits in the past year (since 2025-07-23) that had a pneumonia diagnosis.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT vo.visit_occurrence_id) AS inpatient_pneumonia_encounters
FROM omop.visit_occurrence vo
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
  ON co.visit_occurrence_id = vo.visit_occurrence_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
JOIN omop.concept anc
  ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = anc.concept_id
WHERE vo.visit_concept_id IN (9201, 262)  -- Inpatient Visit, ER+Inpatient
  AND anc.concept_name = 'Pneumonia'
  AND anc.vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED'
  AND vo.visit_start_date >= DATE '2025-07-23'
  AND vo.visit_start_date <= DATE '2026-07-23';
